assumptions.label: continuum fluid
assumptions.statement: Fluid is lowered to continuum or particle-fluid approximation rather than molecular dynamics.

assumptions.label: rigid machine parts
assumptions.statement: Machines are rigid-body assemblies with explicit joints and constraints unless soft compliance is requested.

assumptions.label: coarse biological field
assumptions.statement: Biological growth and signaling compile to reaction-diffusion or agent fields unless molecular detail is requested.

assumptions.label: lumped thermal field
assumptions.statement: Thermal response is lowered to bounded heat transfer and phase fields unless full combustion chemistry is requested.

assumptions.label: queue network
assumptions.statement: Social, logistics, and compute systems are lowered to network flow and queue operators.

assumptions.label: lumped battery cell model

assumptions.label: coarse protein folding

assumptions.label: compliant vessel flow

assumptions.label: semiconductor thermal map
assumptions.statement: Chip prompts use network/power load and heat diffusion over simplified die geometry.

assumptions.label: bridge modal approximation

assumptions.label: water rain
assumptions.statement: Precipitation is treated as liquid water unless acid, methane, ammonia, or other chemistry is stated.

assumptions.label: air atmosphere
assumptions.statement: Open weather scenes use an air atmosphere with bounded humidity and pressure.

assumptions.label: earth-normal gravity
assumptions.statement: Gravity defaults to earth-normal for human-scale scenes unless planetary setting is stated.

assumptions.label: continuum fluid
assumptions.statement: Fluid is lowered to continuum or particle-fluid approximation rather than molecular dynamics.

assumptions.label: rigid machine parts
assumptions.statement: Machines are rigid-body assemblies with explicit joints and constraints unless soft compliance is requested.

assumptions.label: coarse biological field
assumptions.statement: Biological growth and signaling compile to reaction-diffusion or agent fields unless molecular detail is requested.

assumptions.label: lumped thermal field
assumptions.statement: Thermal response is lowered to bounded heat transfer and phase fields unless full combustion chemistry is requested.

assumptions.label: queue network
assumptions.statement: Social, logistics, and compute systems are lowered to network flow and queue operators.

assumptions.label: lumped battery cell model
assumptions.statement: Battery packs are represented as coupled thermal-electrochemical cells, not full electrode microstructure.

assumptions.label: coarse protein folding
assumptions.statement: Protein folding is reduced to coarse chain relaxation, contact hints, and energy basin visuals.

assumptions.label: compliant vessel flow
assumptions.statement: Blood flow uses pressure-driven fluid through elastic vessel boundaries.

assumptions.label: semiconductor thermal map
assumptions.statement: Chip prompts use network/power load and heat diffusion over simplified die geometry.

assumptions.label: bridge modal approximation
assumptions.statement: Bridge resonance uses structural modes, damping, and stress visualization rather than full finite element mesh.

assumptions.label: rigid machine parts

assumptions.label: coarse biological field

assumptions.label: coarse protein folding

assumptions.label: compliant vessel flow

assumptions.label: semiconductor thermal map
